Review Extrovert?

Reviewers consistently say Extrovert makes LinkedIn outreach more focused, personal, and efficient. Users value the customized feed, easy interface, and ability to organize interactions in one place, saying it helps them avoid LinkedIn’s noisy default feed and spend more time on real deal-making and relationship building. Several report stronger engagement, more conversations, and more meetings, especially for B2B sales and ABM. The only clear criticism is a request for referral system management in the dashboard; otherwise, feedback is overwhelmingly positive and practical.

results.content:
Title: Extrovert Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
## Extrovert. ## Be known before you pitch. Stay visible until they buy. # Extrovert Reviews. ### The community submitted 13 reviews to tell us what they like about Extrovert, what Extrovert can do better, and more. Extrovert was ranked #4 of the week for April 15th, 2025. Extrovert was ranked #1 of the day for April 15th, 2025. Extrovert was ranked #2 of the day for October 7th, 2025. Extrovert was ranked #2 of the day for February 8th, 2026. ## Similar Products. ### Engineering & Development. ### LLMs. ### Productivity. ### Marketing & Sales. ### Design & Creative. ### Social & Community. ### Finance. ### AI Agents. ### Trending categories. ### Top reviewed. ### Trending products. ### Top forum threads. #### What's great. The "be known before you pitch" positioning is spot on — cold outreach from a stranger vs someone who's been visibly engaging in your content are completely different conversations. What's the average time from first Extrovert comment to actual deal conversation? Curious about the warming cycle length. In most cases you need 2-3 comments before sending connection request, so it can take ~10-20 days. Then you can expect 4-7 days before the first DM can be sent (time to accept + wait a little after connection). Then it can take anywhere between 3 and 30 days until the first call - so, 15-60 days from starting a campaign to the first call. I used Extrovert to create a customized feed for myself and comment only on people I want to do deals with. It helps me avoid wasting time on LinkedIn and its awful feed, and instead focus straight on actions that actually contribute to closing deals. #### What needs improvement. They could add referral system management directly into the app’s dashboard. #### vs Alternatives. Honestly, I don’t even know of any alternatives.
